payload.name: Store intervals between related events
payload.description: When a message introduces a new event for a subject who already has a stored event of the same type and both event dates are known, during extraction also record the elapsed time between them.
content: During extraction, when a message introduces a new event for a subject who already has a stored event of the same type (e.g., a second adoption or relocation) and both event dates are known, also extract a candidate memory of kind 'event' recording the elapsed time between the two events, e.g., 'three months passed between the first and second adoption'.

Only create this interval memory when the two events are directly comparable (same subject, same event type) and their dates are present in the message or existing memory; skip it when events are unrelated, either date is unknown, or the interval is already stored.

solves: During extraction, when a message introduces a new event that matches a previously stored event of the same type for the same subject and both event dates are known, also add a concise event memory for the elapsed time between them. Applies to future sessions where a later message reveals a second comparable event and a question may ask how much time passed between them. Does not apply when events are unrelated, dates are missing, or the interval is already recorded.
